architecture.title: System story
architecture.subtitle: The interactive browser demo and protected API records stay separate.
steps: The browser demo starts from synthetic data, validates locally, and runs the deterministic check workflow.
Demo drafts, reports, campaign versions, and handoff previews remain in browser localStorage.
The demo does not send PREFLIGHT_API_KEY or claim a persisted backend review run.
Separately, an authenticated POST /api/v1/runs persists an integration run and policy provenance to Postgres.
The API transaction writes blockers and outbox rows; the worker delivers audit first and Telegram best-effort.
Status, API Contract, and Evidence document this protected contract without connecting the demo UI to it.
